Question: In electron microscope, plant cell mitotic late stage cell plate surrounded by many small vesicles. These vesicles belong to which cell structure? What substances may contain?
Options:
A. ER proteins, phospholipids
B. Golgi proteins, phospholipids
C. ER cellulose, pectin
D. Golgi cellulose, pectin
